lines.t: Verse 1
When the noise of life grows loud,
I will come and bow down low,
Lay my burdens at Your feet,
In Your gentle peace I know.
Pre-Chorus
You call my soul to quiet streams,
You lead me where the stillness grows,
I do not have to carry all,
When Your mercy overflows.
Chorus
Trusting YahuShua, Lord of rest,
In Your presence I am blessed,
You are holy, You are near,
Calm my heart and cast out fear.
Trusting YahuShua, day and night,
You are my Shalom, my light,
I will rest beneath Your hand,
Safe within Your holy plan.
Verse 2
Work can wait, the world can pause,
I will enter sacred rest,
Every anxious thought grows still,
In the One who knows me best.
Bridge
Teach my heart to breathe in grace,
Set my spirit free to stay,
In the sweetness of Your rest,
I am made new in Your way.
Final Chorus
Trusting YahuShua, Lord of rest,
In Your presence I am blessed,
You are holy, You are near,
Calm my heart and cast out fear.
Trusting YahuShua, day and night,
You are my Shalom, my light,
I will rest beneath Your hand,
Safe within Your holy plan.
